rows.operation: Render independent base-chain and service states
rows.reason: chainState derives the entire label only from capability.ready; chainDetail shows only the first aggregate reason.
expectedAssertions: Healthy node with a failed protocol remains explicitly node-synced; failed service is separately visible.

rows.operation: Select the actual Bitcoin verification network
rows.reason: getChains$ and getChainStatus$ hardcode network=mainnet; the inspected controller parser rejects signet/testnet4.
expectedAssertions: Bitcoin Signet page cannot consume or label a mainnet health response as its own.

rows.operation: Preserve unknown lag rather than zero
rows.reason: DOGE node and confirmed lag are literal zero; BTC/ZEC health also default missing lag to zero.
expectedAssertions: Absent reference or checkpoint yields null with a reason; measured lag uses exact integer arithmetic.

rows.operation: Keep node, confirmed-index and protocol checkpoints separate
rows.reason: BTC has secondary-tip fallbacks; ZEC uses the indexer checkpoint for node fields; DOGE assigns one chain tip to every protocol.
expectedAssertions: Each checkpoint has the correct authority, chain, network and observation time.

rows.operation: Retain configured sources without checkpoints
rows.reason: bitcoinCapability selects snapshots by checkpoint.chain/network, dropping failures with no checkpoint even though source context exists.
expectedAssertions: An unresponsive configured source stays identifiable as configured-unavailable, not missing.

rows.operation: Include Dunes in all-offered readiness
rows.reason: Per-protocol output includes Dunes, but requiredOrdReady checks only Doginals/DRC20 before overall readiness.
expectedAssertions: Dunes unavailable cannot coexist with allOfferedReady=true when its offered operation is required.

rows.operation: Retain confirmed-history evidence when mempool snapshot is missing
rows.reason: The inspected Zcash branch returns fallback health when status.snapshot is absent before using independent scan/checkpoint fields.
expectedAssertions: scanComplete=true with a valid current confirmed checkpoint and no mempool snapshot does not erase history availability.

rows.operation: Expire old successful observations and recover correctly
rows.reason: Independent timestamp/failure/age invariants have not been executed; code retains prior observations after failure.
expectedAssertions: Old ready data is not represented as freshly measured; subsequent success clears only the resolved fault.

rows.operation: Explain configuration, reachability, coverage and qualification separately
rows.reason: Inspected frontend reason dictionary lacks new confirmed-history-unconfigured wording and still consumes a first aggregate reason.
expectedAssertions: Missing configuration is not described as a source that failed to answer; healthy coverage limits are not faults.

rows.operation: Read actual serving frontend, gateway and overlay revisions
rows.reason: Live HTTP reads failed at the tool access layer; GitHub reads succeeded. No serving revision was established.
